outputs.explanation: Panel A is a micrograph/spatial image showing tissue clusters, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B consists of H&E micrographs with manual region annotations, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C shows spatial heatmap overlays of gene expression on tissue; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel D shows GSEA enrichment plots (line plots), which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.

Panel E is a bar graph of log2 fold change values per gene derived from a single differential expression analysis (Seurat FindMarkers) rather than an average across multiple replicate samples with associated variability; no error bars are shown, indicating each bar is a single computed statistic rather than a mean requiring individual data points.
